descriptors.concept_name: Cost of Acquisition for Specific Intangible and Other Rights
descriptors.definition: The cost of acquisition for specified intangible assets and rights purchased from a previous owner is the actual purchase price. For self-generated assets within this category, the cost of acquisition is treated as nil.
inclusion: Goodwill of a business or profession
Trademark or brand name
Right to manufacture, produce or process any article or thing
Tenancy rights and stage carriage permits
exclusion: Tangible assets such as land or buildings
Assets acquired under circumstances not specified in the section
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from the cost of improvement which is taken as nil for intangible assets under Section 90(1).

descriptors.concept_name: Cost of Improvement for Intangible and Other Assets
descriptors.definition: The cost of improvement for goodwill and other specified intangible assets is taken as nil. For other capital assets, it includes capital expenditures incurred on additions or alterations by the previous owner or the assessee depending on the acquisition timeline and mode.
inclusion: Capital expenditures on additions to tangible capital assets after 1.4.2001
Capital outlays by previous owners where applicable under Section 73
exclusion: Goodwill of a business or profession
Intangible assets like trademarks or manufacturing rights
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from the cost of acquisition, which relates to the initial purchase price or value rather than subsequent capital additions.

descriptors.concept_name: Computation of Capital Gains in Case of Depreciable Assets
descriptors.definition: Capital gains on the transfer of depreciable assets forming part of a block of assets are deemed short-term capital gains when the full value of consideration exceeds the aggregate of transfer expenses, opening written down value, and actual cost of new acquisitions. If an entire block of assets ceases to exist due to full transfer, the resulting excess or deficit is treated accordingly under overriding rules.
inclusion: Assets forming part of a depreciable block of assets
Power sector depreciable assets under specific provisions
exclusion: Non-depreciable capital assets governed by standard holding period criteria for long-term or short-term classification
nearby_distinctions: Overrides standard short-term asset definitions based on holding periods by automatically classifying gains from depreciable asset blocks as short-term.

descriptors.concept_name: Computation of Capital Gains for Market Linked Debentures and Specified Mutual Funds
descriptors.definition: Capital gains arising from the transfer, redemption, or maturity of specified mutual fund units, market linked debentures, or unlisted bonds and debentures are mandatorily treated as short-term capital gains. The gain is computed by deducting the cost of acquisition and transfer expenditures from the full value of consideration without allowing deductions for securities transaction tax.
inclusion: Units of specified mutual funds acquired on or after 1.4.2023
Market linked debentures
Unlisted bonds and debentures transferred or redeemed on or after 23.7.2024
exclusion: Assets whose classification depends upon the traditional holding period rather than statutory overriding rules
nearby_distinctions: Differs from general capital gains provisions by overriding normal holding period requirements and denying securities transaction tax deductions.

descriptors.concept_name: Capital Gains in Respect of Slump Sale
descriptors.definition: A slump sale involves transferring one or more undertakings for a lump sum consideration without assigning values to individual assets and liabilities. The net worth of the undertaking is deemed the cost of acquisition and improvement, while the fair market value serves as the full value of consideration.
inclusion: Transfer of an entire undertaking, division, or business activity for a lump sum
Assets held for more than 36 months taxed as long-term and 36 months or less as short-term
exclusion: Transfer of individual assets or liabilities not constituting an active business undertaking
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from itemized asset sales because individual asset valuation is absent, utilizing undertaking net worth instead.

descriptors.concept_name: Deemed Full Value of Consideration for Land or Building
descriptors.definition: When land or buildings are transferred at a consideration lower than the stamp duty value, the stamp duty value is deemed to be the full value of consideration if it exceeds 110 percent of the actual consideration. Special alignment rules apply when the agreement date and registration date differ and consideration is paid through specified banking or online modes.
inclusion: Transfer of land, buildings, or both
Transactions where stamp duty value exceeds 110 percent of actual proceeds
exclusion: Transactions where the stamp duty value is within 110 percent of the actual sale consideration
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from standard sales where actual consideration received is taken, applying statutory substitution only when thresholds are breached.

descriptors.concept_name: Tax Treatment and Cost Adjustment for Advance Money Received
descriptors.definition: Advance money received during negotiations for a capital asset that is subsequently forfeited must be deducted from the cost of acquisition, written down value, or fair market value unless it has been taxed as income under specific provisions. Advances forfeited on or after 1st April 2014 are taxable under income from other sources, preventing double taxation through cost deductions.
inclusion: Advance money retained following the breakdown of asset transfer negotiations
Advances forfeited before 1st April 2014 for cost reduction purposes
exclusion: Advances received and forfeited by a previous owner rather than the current assessee
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished by timing; advances forfeited before 1-4-2014 reduce acquisition cost, whereas later forfeitures are taxed separately as other income.

descriptors.concept_name: Exemptions for US 64 Units and Compulsory Acquisition of Agricultural Land
descriptors.definition: Capital gains arising from the transfer of Unit Scheme 1964 units are exempt from tax. Similarly, capital gains derived by individuals or Hindu Undivided Families from the compulsory acquisition of urban agricultural land used for farming are exempt under specified conditions.
inclusion: Income from transfer of US 64 units on or after 1.4.2002
Compensation from compulsory acquisition of specified urban agricultural land held by individuals or HUFs
exclusion: Voluntary sales of agricultural land not governed by compulsory acquisition laws or government approvals
nearby_distinctions: Differs from regular taxable capital gains by providing complete statutory exemption based on asset type and acquisition context.

descriptors.concept_name: Reference to Valuation Officer for Capital Assets
descriptors.definition: The Assessing Officer is empowered to refer the valuation of a capital asset to a Valuation Officer to determine its fair market value. This occurs when the value claimed using a registered valuer varies from the true market value or exceeds prescribed percentage and monetary thresholds.
inclusion: Valuation references where assessee valuations differ from market estimates
Discrepancies exceeding 15 percent and ten lakh rupees
exclusion: Asset values accepted by the Assessing Officer without variance or suspicion
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from self-assessed valuations by invoking official valuation machinery to verify transactional or historical baseline figures.

descriptors.concept_name: Tax on Short-Term Capital Gains on Specified Securities
descriptors.definition: Short-term capital gains arising from the transfer of equity shares, equity-oriented fund units, or business trust units are chargeable at a concessional rate of 20 percent if subject to securities transaction tax. Resident individuals and HUFs can adjust unexhausted basic exemption limits against these gains.
inclusion: Equity shares in a company
Units of an equity-oriented fund
Units of a business trust
exclusion: Short-term capital gains not subject to securities transaction tax except specified IFSC transactions
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from ordinary short-term capital gains by offering a flat concessional tax rate and allowing basic exemption adjustments for residents.

descriptors.concept_name: Taxation and Indexation of Long-Term Capital Gains
descriptors.definition: Long-term capital gains on general assets are taxable at a concessional rate of 12.5 percent, with resident individuals and HUFs permitted to absorb unexhausted basic exemption limits. Specific indexation benefits apply to land or buildings acquired before a designated threshold date.
inclusion: Long-term capital assets other than those under section 198
Land or buildings acquired before 23.7.2024 for resident individuals and HUFs
exclusion: Short-term capital gains and assets governed by special equity taxation sections
nearby_distinctions: Differs from section 198 assets by applying to broader long-term asset categories and incorporating potential indexation adjustments for older real estate.

descriptors.concept_name: Tax on Long-Term Capital Gains on Certain Assets
descriptors.definition: Long-term capital gains exceeding one lakh twenty-five thousand rupees derived from equity shares, equity-oriented funds, or business trust units are taxable at 12.5 percent. This rate applies provided securities transaction tax requirements are fulfilled on both acquisition and transfer, subject to notified exceptions.
inclusion: Equity shares in a company subject to STT
Units of equity-oriented funds and business trusts
Exceeding the threshold of one lakh twenty-five thousand rupees
exclusion: Long-term capital gains below the statutory threshold of one lakh twenty-five thousand rupees
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished by imposing a specific monetary exemption threshold and strict mandatory securities transaction tax payment conditions for qualification.
